Pakistan FC KPK | Brotherhood Beyond Duty 🇵🇰
Beyond the challenges of duty, the brave soldiers of Pakistan’s Frontier Corps Khyber Pakhtunkhwa share moments of happiness, laughter, and brotherhood. Whether standing firm in the line of duty or spending their free time together, they support one another, share what they have, and find joy in the simplest moments. Their bond goes beyond uniforms and ranks — built on trust, sacrifice, unity, and the spirit of standing together as one family. Different duties, one brotherhood, one mission — serving Pakistan with honour and pride. 🇵🇰
